voices.who: narrator (blue star-jacket boy), also voicing Fire Chief and Milo
voices.first_words: In this town, every secret you say out loud
voices.sounds_like: ElevenLabs expressive youthful voice / Speech-to-Speech (~80% sure)
voices.gender_age_impression: young teen boy or androgynous youth (approx. 12-15)
voices.pitch_or_speed_effect: other (sped up ~1.1x with mild upward pitch shift and trimmed breaths)
voices.delivery: animated, whimsical, and brisk in Act 1; urgent, strained, and emotionally raw in Acts 2-3
voices.timing_notes: Brisk Act 1 worldbuilding (0:00.0-0:36.1) with micro-pauses (0:08.1, 0:11.0, 0:29.8); 0.2s pivot pause at 0:37.5 before the blizzard; gruff urgent bark as Fire Chief (0:41.1-0:42.4); escalating shouts at 0:49.0, 0:57.0, 0:59.7, and 1:07.5 peaking in a voice-cracking 'three years that I'm not his!' (1:09.8-1:11.3); soft raspy whisper-shout for Milo's 'You idiot!' (1:30.4-1:31.2).

one_voice_plays_several_characters: yes — one youthful voice performs narrator, Fire Chief (0:41.1-0:42.4), and Milo (1:30.4-1:31.2), separated purely by vocal acting (gruff bark, voice-cracking shout, teary rasp) with no separate TTS swap or filter.

music.description: playful pizzicato strings and marimba/woodwinds, whimsical storybook comedy
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Starts at 0:00.0 under sunny town rules and Milo's goofy secrets, fading cleanly at 0:37.6 after 'I swore I'd never tell' to set up the sudden blizzard.

music.description: tense minor-key piano and sustained strings, urgent and cold
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Enters at 0:37.7 with howling wind on 'biggest blizzard in 100 years', pulsing tensely as three small mice freeze (0:55.8, 0:59.1, 1:02.6) and swelling into the narrator's shouted confession (1:07.5-1:11.3).

music.description: warm soaring major-key piano and legato strings, hopeful resolution
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Blooms into warm major-key strings/piano as the horse-sized mouse spawns (1:11.5-1:13.5), carrying the forest rescue (1:17.6), softening under Milo's 'You idiot!' (1:30.4), and resolving over the cat button joke (1:39.8).

sound_effects.sound: smoke poof, swarming squeaks, girl scream (to 0:15.6)
smoke poof into 0:59.1 ice crackle (2nd mouse)
smoke poof into 1:02.6 ice crackle (3rd mouse)
booming giant smoke poof + heavy thud

ambience: Dry storybook backdrop (0:00.0-0:38.1, brief cafeteria commotion 0:13.4-0:15.6), continuous howling blizzard wind from 0:38.2 to 1:34.5 (+25 dB <120 Hz energy), then quiet sunny air (1:34.5-1:39.8).
sync_with_picture: Smoke clouds and gray mice pop on puff/squeak SFX (0:02.2, 0:13.4, 0:51.2, 1:12.7, 1:31.4); cafeteria chaos lands on '300 mice' (0:13.4); meow hits ':3' cat cut (0:20.8); 0:38.2 flips town to snow with wind + minor piano; blue ice snaps onto mice on frost crackles (0:55.8, 0:59.1, 1:02.6); screen shake matches 1:11.4 rumble; snout steam matches 1:25.1 booming whisper; cat flops with 'X X' eyes on 1:37.5 thud.
faces_and_mouths: No phoneme lip-sync; 2D decals stay static during narration and snap on beats: 'O' eyes on reveals (0:02.3, 0:07.0), scream mouth (0:13.9), smug grin (0:22.3), desperate shouting mouths (0:48.8, 0:56.9, 1:06.0), waterfall blue tears on 'not his!' (1:10.0), town gasps (1:27.8), Milo's gape to teary smile (1:29.0-1:30.1), and cat ':3' to 'X X' (1:37.5).
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Act 1 fires three goofy Milo secrets in 7s (0:28.7 duck light, 0:30.3 shoes, 0:31.8 fence), then Act 2 reuses them as an accelerating survival countdown (shouts at 0:49.0, 0:57.0, 0:59.7; ice snaps at 0:55.8, 0:59.1, 1:02.6) before the raw emotional confession (1:07.5-1:11.3), undercut warmly by 'a mouse that big can't whisper' (1:26.3) and Milo's 'You idiot!' spawning a second giant mouse (1:30.4-1:31.4).
first_3_seconds: Fast bright narration at 0:00.0 ('In this town, every secret you say out loud turns into a gray mouse') over 118 BPM pizzicato strings, punctuated at 0:02.2 by a smoke-poof pop + mouse squeak — instant high-concept fantasy hook.
ending: After the cat's faint thud (1:37.5), 'It hasn't chased a mouse since' finishes at 1:39.6 with a 0.2s warm string decay to 1:39.8 — a resolved storybook button rather than a loop cut.
mix: Clean voice-forward mix (-14.4 LUFS, LRA 3.7 LU, +0.1 dBTP) with 72.7% energy in 250 Hz-4 kHz; dry upfront voice stays clear even over the sub-heavy (<250 Hz) blizzard wind bed (0:38.2-1:34.5).
why_the_sound_works: Zero-delay premise + diegetic 'poof + squeak' at 0:02.2 hooks scrollers immediately.
3-act musical/ambient score (118 BPM pizzicato -> 110 BPM minor piano + wind -> warm major strings) gives cinematic arc.
Scale contrast—tiny squeaks/ice-snaps (0:51.2-1:02.6) vs. sub-bass ground tremor + giant poof (1:11.4-1:12.7)—sells the climax.
Expressive voice crack (1:09.8) and raspy 'You idiot!' whisper (1:30.4) land genuine emotion.
unsure_about: Whether the narrator is ElevenLabs Speech-to-Speech guided by a human take or expressive neural TTS (human-like crack at 1:09.8 and rasp at 1:30.4 inside synthetic studio timbre); library titles of the 3 underscore cues left null.
